acceptanceCriteria: A Playwright receipt with rootDir=e2e/ yields repo-relative location paths; a test covers both the bound and unbound cases.
body: Residual from V1-2045 (PR #1319). Stock Playwright reports spec file paths relative to its rootDir; locations are repo-relative only when rootDir is the repository root, otherwise absent with repository-root-unbound. Expected: resolve rootDir (config or receipt) and emit repo-relative paths, refusing only when unbound.

title: Playwright spec paths relative to a non-root rootDir make test-validity locations absent with repository-root-unbound
